actions.action: If any spots look fuzzy, wipe them with a cotton swab and rubbing alcohol
Check the crevices near the rosette centers for white cottony mealybugs
Give the plants more light: 6+ hours of direct sun, or a grow light 6-12 inches away for 10-14 hours on a timer, increased gradually
Water only when the soil is fully dry, soaking the soil (not the leaves) and letting it drain
Repot into cactus mix amended with about 50% perlite or pumice
Optionally behead stretched plants, let the cuttings callus, then set them on dry soil to root

reason: The answer names insufficient light and etiolation as the main cause, correctly explains the farina, and its main advice of more sun or a close grow light matches the fix; the extra suggestions are not harmful.
